Genospectra: Iatrocide

Uncovering Medical Genocide: Truth, Memory, Resistance

Iatrocide confronts systemic medical abuse with survivor-led archives—exposing incitement, denial, and neglect. We don't just document harm. We name it, trace it, and demand accountability.

Our Mission

Genospectra: Iatrocide is a survivor-led initiative committed to exposing medical genocidal incitement and unethical practices. We document testimonies and evidence to raise awareness, promote accountability, and inspire systemic change within healthcare institutions.

Unveiling Medical Atrocities to Inspire Reform

Extensive Survivor-Led Archives

Discover meticulously documented cases revealing medical field abuses and incitement.

Interactive Awareness Tools

Engage with dynamic resources designed to educate and mobilize public action.

Community Advocacy Network

Connect with activists and experts dedicated to ethical reform and justice.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the mission of Genospectra: Iatrocide?

We document and expose genocidal incitement and ethical breaches within healthcare to promote justice and change.

Who leads the Genospectra: Iatrocide initiative?

Survivors with firsthand experience guide our work to ensure authentic representation and impact.

How can I access the archival records?

Our digital archive is accessible online, providing comprehensive documentation for public research.

How does Genospectra: Iatrocide support advocacy?

By raising awareness, we encourage policy reforms and ethical accountability in the medical field.
